art.title: POV: your first meal in Japan

gags: freeze snap inside a moving clip (server + diners freeze staring at the upright chopsticks, steam and lanterns keep moving; hands push the chopsticks in)
WRONG WAY / RIGHT WAY verdict stamps (overlays on moving footage)
silence-to-shout (server: お箸は立てないで！)
the wait (server cooking at the wok, diners eating, POV hands still beside the untouched rice bowl)
pdca.hook: Don't stand your chopsticks in the rice.
pdca.note: 2026-11-20 morning slot: food, all 6 food topics in queue were used, so 3 new food topics added per TOPICS.md policy (chopsticks_rice / slurp_noodles / pour_beer) and the first used. Hook adapts hook_library #1 (Tier A: wrong action within 1s, freeze/stare, staff shout) — upright chopsticks in the rice bowl as the wrong action. Every scene beat a real i2v clip under the all-animation rule; freeze snap inside the freeze clip, verdict reuses freeze clip at in 1.0 (chopsticks upright, stamp lands at +0.35s), punch merged into payoff; f2 verdict wide and f5 server close-up kept as sources. Bubble two lines (お箸は / 立てないで！) at [660,360], same proven spot as ep10-ep15.
pdca.rule: Never stick your chopsticks upright in rice — it looks like a funeral offering.
